
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Counts the number of non-NaN elements in a one-dimensional ndarray.

    If provided an empty ndarray, the function returns `0`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a one-dimensional input ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Count.

    Examples
    --------
    > var vector = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor}};
    > var x = vector( [ 1.0, NaN, 3.0 ], 'generic' );
    > {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    2

    See Also
    --------
